tasks.name: Add SceneManagerTest
tasks.description:
Create a new test file at modules/application/src/test/java/io/github/conava/chess/application/navigation/SceneManagerTest.java. The test class should verify SceneManager behavior without requiring full FXML loading where possible.

Minimum 4-5 test methods:

1. accessors_returnInjectedDependencies: Construct SceneManager with mock/stub dependencies (Stage, Chess, ThemeManager, I18n, SettingsService via Mockito). Assert all five getters (getPrimaryStage, getChess, getThemeManager, getI18n, getSettingsService) return the exact objects passed to the constructor. This test does NOT require JavaFX toolkit initialization.

2. showConfirm_beforeSceneShown_throwsIllegalStateException: Construct SceneManager without calling any show* method first. Call showConfirm("test") and assert it throws IllegalStateException with a message containing "OverlayManager is not ready".

3. dismissOverlay_beforeSceneShown_throwsIllegalStateException: Same as above but call dismissOverlay() instead.

4-5. If JavaFX toolkit is available (use Platform.startup(() -> {}) in @BeforeAll with a try-catch for IllegalStateException if already running), test that showMainMenu/showGame/showSettings set expected stage properties. These tests require running on the FX thread -- use Platform.runLater + CountDownLatch pattern. Mock Chess, ThemeManager (registerScene should be a no-op), I18n (getBundle returns a ListResourceBundle), SettingsService. Create a real Stage on the FX thread. After showMainMenu: stage is not maximized. After showGame: stage is maximized. After showSettings: stage is not maximized.

Note: showGame() now takes a RulesetOptions parameter (from task-2), so use showGame(RulesetOptions.STANDARD) in tests.

Use JUnit 5 and Mockito (both already in the project's test dependencies). If FXML-loading tests fail in headless CI, annotate them with @DisabledIfSystemProperty or similar condition.

tasks.name: Rewrite modules/application/CLAUDE.md
tasks.description:
Completely rewrite modules/application/CLAUDE.md to reflect the current JavaFX-based application. The existing file describes a Swing application that no longer exists. Follow the same section structure as modules/core/CLAUDE.md for consistency.

Required sections:

1. Status: Active JavaFX application. Swing-to-JavaFX migration is complete.

2. Responsibility: Desktop GUI and executable entry point. Uses JavaFX with FXML + Controller pattern. Delegates all game logic to core via the Chess facade.

3. Package Structure (current reality):
   - io.github.conava.chess.application -- Entry point (Chess.java extends Application)
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.controllers -- FXML controllers: GameController, GameEndController, MainMenuController, OfflineSetupController, OnlineSetupController, PromotionController, SettingsController, WaitingController
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.navigation -- SceneManager, OverlayManager
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.i18n -- I18n (ResourceBundle wrapper)
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.theme -- ThemeManager, Theme, BoardTheme
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.settings -- SettingsService
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.network -- ServerCommunicationTask
   - io.github.conava.chess.application.tasks -- ExecuteMove (Runnable, not SwingWorker)

4. Key Classes: Brief descriptions of Chess, SceneManager, OverlayManager, GameController, GameEndController, MainMenuController, and setup controllers. Note that GameController implements GameObserver and uses Platform.runLater for UI updates.

5. Design Patterns: Facade (Chess), Observer (GameController implements GameObserver), FXML+Controller (all screens), Strategy (RulesetOptions passed through facade).

6. Architecture Law Compliance: All five laws, all compliant.

7. Known Debt: Remove all Swing-era items. Current items if any (e.g., startGame silently refuses if game exists).

Do NOT reference any Swing classes (JFrame, JPanel, JDialog, SwingWorker, ColorScheme, BoardPanel, BoardButton, MainFrame, etc.). Everything must reflect the current JavaFX codebase.
